coverage_definition: Finite non-goal candidate needs its own next decision, recursively for each declared depth. Unreachable branches retain labels but cannot have successful continuation. Counts refer to training bank only.
hypothesis: Largest known structural gap is target-basin state coverage: 5179 decisions versus 470487 finite non-goal relations for the same 167 targets. Optimal-only closure does not cover all recoverable repeated deviations.
